course_name_en: Modeling and Simulation of Mechanical Systems

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the physical and mathematical fundamentals of mechanical systems.
Know essential techniques for modeling mechanical systems.
Be able to analyze mechanical models.
Be able to implement and simulate simple mechanical models in MATLAB.

syllabus_topics: Review and deepening of the fundamentals of technical dynamics
Modeling approaches for rigid body systems
Applications (including from the field of automotive engineering)
